note: The root key records the consonants of the whole place name. Its first element is the construct of בַּיִת.
summary: Bethel lay west of Ai, with Abram’s campsite between the two towns. Genesis connects the name with Jacob’s description of the place as the house of God.

senses.definition: The town west of Ai that marks the western side of Abram’s campsite.

evidence.note: Abram travels as far as Bethel and returns to the place where his tent had stood between Bethel and Ai.
Abram pitches his tent with Bethel to the west and Ai to the east.
Jacob calls the place בֵּית אֱלֹהִים, “house of God,” and names it בֵּית אֵל. The narrator gives Luz as the town’s former name.

senses.gloss: Bethel, the town west of Ai
